d: Salla is one of the fastest-growing e-commerce platforms in the MENA region, delivering innovative technology solutions that empower businesses to scale rapidly. As we continue to expand, we are seeking a Category Manager – Mahally.

As Category Manager, you own what gets featured, analyze what's selling, curate the best products, build the lists for every major campaign, and work with marketing and growth teams closely on campaigns. Your decisions directly impact GMV.
q: Experience: Minimum 3+ years in category management or marketplace operations on large-scale eCommerce platforms, with a proven ability to drive category performance and GMV growth.
SKU Management: Experience managing 50,000+ SKUs, including curating top-performing products, maintaining listing quality, and optimizing product visibility for campaigns.

Data & Analytics: Proficiency in SQL for extracting and analyzing your own data, with experience using analytics/BI tools such as Metabase, Looker, or equivalent. Able to generate insights to inform category decisions.

Traffic & Marketing: Demonstrated knowledge of key traffic-driving mechanisms, including Search, Email, SEO, and Affiliates, and ability to coordinate campaigns with marketing and growth teams to maximize engagement and GMV.

Consumer & Market Insight: Strong understanding of consumer behavior and market dynamics, with the ability to analyze category performance, identify trends, opportunities, and gaps, and adapt strategies based on competitor activity.
Language: Proficiency in both Arabic and English, spoken and written.
r: li
Build the yearly promotional calendar: 11.11, White Friday, Ramadan, Eids, National Day, Founding Day, pay week and seasonal moments.
li
Choose the focus categories for each campaign, based on what's selling and what the season calls for.
li
Build the product lists for each campaign and set a GMV target for it.
li
Own the category tree in Arabic and English, organised around how people shop, not how merchants list.
li
Find winning products and merchants: right price vs market, real demand, reliable delivery. Bring in merchants who aren't selling on Mahally yet.
li
Own merchandising: decide which products, stores and categories go into homepage banners, store tiles, category tiles and search, refresh them on schedule, and replace what doesn't perform.
li
Work with CRM, marketing and growth on targeting and timing.
li
Analyze category performance and watch competitor marketplaces to spot trends, opportunities and gaps, then adjust the strategy.

d: Binance is a leading global blockchain ecosystem behind the world’s largest cryptocurrency exchange by trading volume and registered users. We are trusted by 300+ million people in 100+ countries for our industry-leading security, user fund transparency, trading engine speed, deep liquidity, and an unmatched portfolio of digital-asset products. Binance offerings range from trading and finance to education, research, payments, institutional services, and more. Our mission is to increase the freedom of money and financial access for people around the world.

Serve as a senior legal counsel for Binance’s global Corporate Legal Affairs team, delivering complex strategic projects together with corporate transactions, governance, reorganisations, intra-group arrangements, board secretarial and entity management.
q: Qualified to practice law in a leading jurisdiction with significant corporate legal experience.
Typically 8+ years of post qualification experience (as a guide) working at a top law firm and/or in-house at a well-established corporate or high-growth company.
Ideally trained in a reputable law firm within the corporate practice with a focus on corporate transactional work and general corporate governance.
Proven expertise in managing complex projects across multiple jurisdictions globally.
Possesses strong legal technical expertise as well as exceptional business acumen and people skills.
Comfortable working in a fast-paced in-house environment is essential.
Strong team player and good business sense.
Hands on at work and can be independent in managing complex projects whilst still working as part of a team.
Ability to come up with and execute creative solutions to meet current and evolving business needs.
Excellent legal drafting and interpretation skills.
Excellent problem solving, analytical and organisational skills.
Collaborate with world-class talent in a user-centric global organization with a flat structure
Tackle challenging projects in a fast-paced and innovative enviornment with autonomy
Thrive in a results-driven workplace with opportunities for career growth and continuous learning
Remote-first, work-from-home arrangement (may vary depending on the nature of the role and team)

d: HanmiGlobal Saudi is looking for a dedicated Transport Engineer to plan, design, and manage transportation systems and infrastructure to ensure efficient and sustainable mobility solutions. The successful candidate will work closely with multidisciplinary teams to develop transport strategies that align with project goals and regulatory requirements.
q: Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering, Transportation Engineering, or related field.
Minimum 15 years of experience in transportation planning, design, and management.
Proficiency in transportation modeling software such as VISSIM, TransCAD, or SYNCHRO.
Strong understanding of traffic engineering principles, transport policies, and regulations.
Excellent analytical, communication, and project management skills.
Experience working on infrastructure projects in Saudi Arabia or similar regions is preferred.
r: li
Conduct transportation studies including traffic analysis, demand forecasting, and impact assessments.
li
Design and evaluate transport networks, including roads, transit systems, pedestrian, and cycling infrastructure.
li
Develop transportation models and simulations to support design decisions.
li
Prepare technical reports, designs, and specifications for transportation projects.
li
Coordinate with government agencies, consultants, and stakeholders to ensure compliance with regulations.
li
Monitor project progress and assist in resolving technical issues during construction phases.
li
Promote sustainable transport solutions and best engineering practices.
li
Support budgeting, scheduling, and resource allocation for transport projects.
